candidates.source_name: ČNB – Seznamy regulovaných a registrovaných subjektů (JERRS), hub page
candidates.why_relevant: Master hub for every ČNB-maintained register (banks, payment institutions, e-money, small-scale providers, intermediaries). It is the canonical pointer to the full population of CZ regulated actors whose leadership/organisation changes are the A5 signal, and it links onward to JERRS, open data and WS JERRS.
candidates.legal_status: public sector information published by the central bank
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly HTML crawl of the hub to detect new/renamed registers; use as seed list for the JERRS and open-data collectors.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs-language search on register terminology, then direct fetch of the hub page
queries_used: ČNB seznam regulovaných a registrovaných subjektů platební instituce

candidates.source_name: JERRS – Seznam regulovaných a registrovaných subjektů (search application)
candidates.why_relevant: The live licensing register itself: per-entity authorisation wording, scope of activity, grant date, and current status (valid / suspended / revoked). New entries mark new market entrants; status changes mark exits — both are direct A5 organisation-change signals with legal reliability.
candidates.access_status: public web application; URL path form may differ per entry point (a login/error variant apl.cnb.cz/apljerrsdad/JERRS.WEB45.LOGIN_A?p_lang=cz was also seen in results)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Prefer the WS JERRS SOAP/XML services or the open-data CSV over scraping this UI; use the UI only for spot checks and for register types not exposed machine-readably.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs search result + snowball from the ČNB seznamy hub
queries_used: ČNB seznam regulovaných a registrovaných subjektů platební instituce
candidates.observed_blocker: URL form unverified — treat exact deep-link as a hypothesis

candidates.source_name: ČNB – Webové služby WS JERRS (machine-readable register API)
candidates.why_relevant: Documented XML web services (three services, XML request → XML response) exposing JERRS data to external consumers since 1 July 2019. This is the single highest-value automation target in the cell: it turns the legally-mandated register into a diffable feed of entities, roles and statuses.
candidates.access_status: public documentation; service usage conditions to be confirmed from the WSDL/terms
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch WSDL + XSD from this page, implement a scheduled SOAP client per register role, snapshot XML and diff daily/weekly.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs search on 'webové služby WS JERRS' then hub snowball
queries_used: ČNB WS JERRS webové služby open data seznam subjektů dokumentace

candidates.source_name: ČNB – Otevřená data (open datasets, CSV download endpoint)
candidates.why_relevant: Seven CSV+JSON-schema datasets published under Government Regulation 425/2016 Sb., including banks and foreign bank branches, exchange offices, non-bank consumer-credit providers and credit intermediaries, with IČO and address fields. Lowest-friction structured baseline of the regulated population for entity resolution against commercial-register officer data.
candidates.legal_status: open data under nařízení vlády č. 425/2016 Sb.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled GET of https://jerrs.cnb.cz/apljerrsdad/JERRS.OPENDATA.STAHUJ?p_seznam=<n> per dataset id; store snapshots and diff on IČO.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of the ČNB open-data page reached from the seznamy hub
queries_used: ČNB WS JERRS webové služby open data seznam subjektů dokumentace

negative_findings.description: No public ČNB register of individually approved persons (a searchable 'seznam osob se souhlasem s výkonem funkce' listing approved board members and key function holders) was found in either cs or en searching.
negative_findings.result_summary: ČNB publishes entity registers (JERRS) and final enforcement decisions, but approvals of individual statutory-body members appear not to be published as a person-level list; the observable trace is the downstream commercial-register entry.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's highest-precision hypothesis — a machine-readable feed of approved individuals — does not hold as stated. A5 leadership detection for CZ must be built on ČNB entity registers joined to obchodní rejstřík officer diffs, not on a ČNB person register.

negative_findings.description: The 30-day advance notification duty for changes in the composition of statutory bodies and supervisory boards (reported in secondary legal press, tied to §8ab of the Banking Act) has no located public disclosure channel.
negative_findings.result_summary: Notifications are filed to ČNB; no public feed, gazette section or dataset publishing these prior notifications was found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The earliest possible leadership signal (~30 days pre-change) exists in law but is not observable, which caps how early A5 can detect CZ bank board moves through official channels.

negative_findings.description: Exact deep-link forms for the JERRS application, the ČNB press-release cs listing, the annual supervision report landing page, and the ARES canonical domain were not confirmed by fetch.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search surfaced variant URLs (apl.cnb.cz login/error path, /export/sites PDF paths, ares.cz vs ares.gov.cz, mf.gov.cz vs mfcr.gov.cz); the parent pages that were fetched (seznamy hub, open data) resolved cleanly.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream verification must resolve these variants before collectors are pinned; a 404 on a guessed deep link should not be read as the source being dead.

negative_findings.description: Access terms, rate limits and any registration requirement for WS JERRS were not established.
negative_findings.result_summary: The documentation page describes three XML services and a standardised request/response flow, but the fetch summary did not expose endpoint URLs, WSDL location, or usage conditions.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: WS JERRS is the cell's best automation target; unresolved access terms are the main implementation risk for the whole A5 CZ register pipeline.

coverage_gaps.description: No person-level official feed links a named individual to an approved role at a named regulated CZ entity; the join must be reconstructed from entity registers plus commercial-register officer changes.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Design the CZ A5 leadership collector as an IČO-keyed join: ČNB open data / WS JERRS for the regulated population → ARES/obchodní rejstřík statutory-body diffs → optional confirmation from company press releases.

coverage_gaps.description: ČNB open data covers only seven datasets (banks, exchange offices, consumer-credit providers and intermediaries) — payment institutions, e-money institutions and small-scale providers appear only via JERRS/WS JERRS, not as plain CSV.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Confirm which JERRS roles WS JERRS exposes for PI/EMI/PSPMR and build the SOAP client; fall back to structured scraping of the JERRS UI only if the services do not cover those roles.

coverage_gaps.description: Sector self-regulatory and professional bodies adjacent to the statutory regulators (Česká bankovní asociace, Česká asociace pro platební styk / fintech associations) were not scouted in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assign a sibling cell to industry associations — they publish board and committee appointments naming senior bank and payments executives, complementing the regulator-side view.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language ČNB mirrors were confirmed for press releases and payments licensing, but it was not established whether the registers, open data and final-decision listings have equivalent en versions.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: During verification, probe /en/ counterparts of each cs register URL and record whether the en mirror is complete or partial, so bilingual matching rules can be set.

coverage_gaps.description: No historical/archived snapshots of the CZ registers were identified, so back-testing leadership-change detection over past years is not currently possible from official sources.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Start own snapshot archiving immediately, and check whether the national open data catalogue (data.gov.cz) or web archives hold prior ČNB register versions.

brief: The CZ regulator layer is unusually well instrumented at the ENTITY level and largely silent at the PERSON level. ČNB concentrates everything in JERRS, exposed three ways — an interactive register, seven open CSV datasets under nařízení vlády 425/2016 Sb., and documented WS JERRS XML web services — making new entrants, licence scope and licence withdrawal cheaply diffable, and this is reinforced by the pravomocná rozhodnutí archive, the annual Zpráva o výkonu dohledu, and ČNB's own press releases and Bank Board page for regulator-side leadership and reorganisation. What was NOT found is any public ČNB list of individuals approved under the souhlas s výkonem funkce / vhodnost a způsobilost regime, nor any disclosure of the 30-day advance notifications of statutory-body changes; the practical A5 route is therefore an IČO-keyed join from ČNB registers to obchodní rejstřík / ARES statutory-body diffs, with EBA's PSD2 central register as an independent cross-check on the payments population. Priority build order: WS JERRS and ČNB open data, then the commercial-register officer diff, then press releases, enforcement decisions and the ČNB vacancy board as corroborating and leading indicators.
